title: Nowcast3D for effective precipitation nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2511.04659v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The evolution of extreme precipitation depends on height-varying wind fields and coupled physical processes, underscoring the importance of three-dimensional information for precipitation nowcasting. Radar volume scans provide such an observational basis. Most learning-based systems, however, either compress these scans into two-dimensional products, losing vertical information needed for height-dependent storm evolution, or rely on purely data-driven mappings that inadequately represent the physical evolution of extreme precipitation. We introduce Nowcast3D, a gray-box learning framework for 3D radar-volume nowcasting, which integrates physically structured neural operators with a conditional diffusion model. The neural operators produce a physics-guided forecast via 3D advection, local diffusion and microphysics processes. translated_abstract: 极端降水的演变依赖于随高度变化的风场和相互耦合的物理过程，这凸显了三维信息对降水临近预报的重要性。雷达体扫数据提供了这样的观测基础。然而，大多数基于学习的系统要么将这些体扫数据压缩为二维产品，丢失了刻画随高度变化的风暴演变所需的垂直信息，要么依赖纯粹数据驱动的映射，无法充分表征极端降水的物理演变。我们提出了Nowcast3D，一个面向三维雷达体扫临近预报的灰箱学习框架，它将具有物理结构的神经算子与条件扩散模型相结合。神经算子通过三维平流、局地扩散和微物理过程生成物理引导的预报；以此预报为条件，扩散模型生成具有不确定性量化的集合预报。
tldr: 提出灰箱学习框架Nowcast3D，将物理结构化神经算子（三维平流、局地扩散与微物理过程）与条件扩散模型相结合，直接基于三维雷达体扫数据实现物理引导且不确定性量化的降水临近预报。
en_tdlr: Nowcast3D is a gray-box framework that combines physically structured neural operators (3D advection, local diffusion, and microphysics) with a conditional diffusion model to deliver physics-guided, uncertainty-quantified precipitation nowcasting directly from 3D radar volume scans.
